$comment: The pinned FFmpeg builds, by `<os>-<arch>` as Rust names them: what Tools::find_or_download installs (the `download` feature) and what `mise run tools` stages for the tests (scripts/downloads.ts). The parity references belong to these exact builds (docs/parity.md): change a URL or a checksum only with new references. The Linux archives are John Van Sickle's 7.0.2 static builds, served from a copy on Hugging Face (Freonius/jerome-sources, pinned by commit), as johnvansickle.com moves older builds away. An entry may list other copies of the same archive (the same SHA-256, so the same references) in an optional `mirrors` array of URLs, tried in order after `url`: { "url": "https://first.example/ff.zip", "mirrors": ["https://second.example/ff.zip"], "sha256": "..." }. Each source is tried up to three times when it fails for a passing reason (the name or the connection, a timeout, a cut-off body, HTTP 429 or 5xx); another 4xx or other bytes move on to the next at once.
